verdict.rationale: BILL markets "AI-powered spend management" that automatically categorizes transactions (docs-9), and an Invoice Coding Agent that auto-codes multi-line bills (docs-8). These are AI-generated suggestions applied to the user's data inside the product, but they are automation of categorization and coding rather than true insights or recommendations surfaced to the user. Missing for 10: in-product AI insights or analytics on spend data, proactive recommendations or anomaly surfacing, detailed documentation of how the AI suggestions are presented, independent or hands-on corroboration.
